H-STOREINIT runs the property store's own module init (0x503ee2d6, the fifth of the settings init chain 0x503dae30) between the registry bootstrap and the DB init, as the boot orders them, and the play session's mode dial starts at P, the start's mode (docs/om1-settings-spec.md 2.2, docs/om1-input-spec.md section 2, model-survey finding 27). With it the store init runs about 3.5 M fewer instructions (the reset reaches the mode store's objects through their pointer words), so in the sessions that run the native store every later interrupt is presented at another instruction count: their devices, stops and harness layers change, and the replayed outcomes and check outputs that report them; the play sessions also list H-STOREINIT among the stand-ins, and the dial's start changes the idle key image. check_perf's run/perf and run/perf-fault print the re-pinned count. The display, OSD and other sessions without the store are unchanged. One screen changes, inputs': with the dial at S under the start's P screen the Fn lever's change made the application change mode to S and close the menu; with the dial at P it changes nothing and the session ends in the menu (X).
